newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - June 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - June 5.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Thursday, as reported by Kyodo news agency:
-- NEC Corp to introduce "green" procurement system in October to cut purchases of harmful materials.
-- About 30 major firms, including Kao Corp, Shiseido Co Ltd and Daiei Inc, are to standardise their distribution systems.
-- Posts and Telecommunications Ministry is considering strengthening measures against hackers and viruses on the Internet.
-- Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) may hold its party presidential election in August.
-- Tokyo prosecutors eye filing charges against Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd for extending loans to a corporate racketeer.
-- Two former executives of Nomura Securities Co Ltd indicted.
